question: Should OpenClaw establish the proposed public plugin emission and manifest-permission contract for AI safety events now, or land only a narrower core-owned telemetry foundation first?
rationale: This choice fixes the permanent SDK and trust boundary, so it cannot be resolved safely by a mechanical patch or contributor proof alone.

options.title: Stage a core-owned foundation
options.body: Land or redesign only the internal, provenance-preserving telemetry path and defer plugin manifest permissions until there is an approved external use case.

options.title: Approve the plugin contract
options.body: Adopt the public API only with explicit ownership, privacy/provenance semantics, upgrade documentation, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the broader proposal on the canonical feature issue until maintainers choose a supported observability product direction.

recommendation.title: Stage a core-owned foundation
recommendation.body: Land or redesign only the internal, provenance-preserving telemetry path and defer plugin manifest permissions until there is an approved external use case.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows ownership of the trusted diagnostics subscription boundary that the proposed SDK surface extends.
